differentials.name: Acute Coronary Syndrome (STEMI / NSTEMI)
differentials.highYield: Retrosternal crushing pain radiating to left arm/jaw, diaphoresis. ST elevations on ECG, elevated troponin.

differentials.name: Aortic Dissection
differentials.highYield: Sudden tearing chest pain radiating to the back. Asymmetric pulses, widened mediastinum on CXR, CTA diagnostic.

differentials.name: Pulmonary Embolism
differentials.highYield: Pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, tachycardia, deep vein thrombosis risk factors. Elevated D-dimer, CTA pulmonary.

differentials.name: Tension Pneumothorax
differentials.highYield: Sudden pleuritic pain, absent breath sounds, tracheal deviation AWAY from affected side. Immediate needle decompression.

differentials.name: Cardiac Tamponade
differentials.highYield: Beck triad (hypotension, JVD, muffled heart sounds), pulsus paradoxus > 10 mmHg. Electrical alternans.

differentials.name: Boerhaave Syndrome (Esophageal Rupture)
differentials.highYield: Violent retching followed by severe retrosternal pain, subcutaneous emphysema, pneumomediastinum on CXR.

differentials.name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
differentials.highYield: Burning substernal pain aggravated by supine posture, relieved by antacids.

differentials.name: Costochondritis
differentials.highYield: Reproducible chest wall tenderness on palpation of costochondral junctions.

differentials.name: Atrial Fibrillation / Flutter
differentials.highYield: Irregularly irregular rhythm, absent P waves. Risk of stroke requires CHA2DS2-VASc scoring.

differentials.name: Supraventricular Tachycardia (AVNRT / AVRT)
differentials.highYield: Sudden paroxysmal narrow-complex tachycardia, terminated by vagal maneuvers or adenosine.

differentials.name: Premature Ventricular Contractions (PVCs)
differentials.highYield: Skipped beat sensation followed by compensatory pause. Wide QRS complexes.

differentials.name: Hyperthyroidism
differentials.highYield: Sinus tachycardia, heat intolerance, tremor, weight loss. Low TSH, elevated free T4.

differentials.name: Vasovagal Syncope (Neurocardiogenic)
differentials.highYield: Prodrome of nausea, warmth, diaphoresis, pallor triggered by pain, sight of blood, or prolonged standing.

differentials.name: Aortic Stenosis
differentials.highYield: Exertional syncope, angina, and dyspnea (SAD triad). Harsh crescendo-decrescendo systolic murmur at right 2nd ICS radiating to carotids.

differentials.name: Orthostatic Hypotension
differentials.highYield: Drop in SBP > 20 mmHg or DBP > 10 mmHg on standing. Dehydration or autonomic dysfunction.

differentials.name: Acute Congestive Heart Failure
differentials.highYield: Bilateral basal crackles, elevated JVP, S3 gallop, orthopnea, PND, elevated BNP.

differentials.name: COPD Exacerbation
differentials.highYield: Increased sputum volume, purulence, and dyspnea in a patient with smoking history.

differentials.name: Pneumonia
differentials.highYield: Fever, productive cough, localized bronchial breath sounds, dullness to percussion, focal infiltrate on CXR.

differentials.name: Anaphylaxis
differentials.highYield: Dyspnea with stridor, wheezing, urticaria, hypotension after allergen exposure. Intramuscular epinephrine.

differentials.name: Upper Airway Cough Syndrome (PND)
differentials.highYield: Cobblestoning of posterior oropharynx, throat clearing, responds to first-gen antihistamines.

differentials.name: Cough-Variant Asthma
differentials.highYield: Nocturnal cough triggered by cold air or exercise, methacholine challenge positive.

differentials.name: ACE-Inhibitor Induced Cough
differentials.highYield: Dry hacking cough beginning weeks to months after ACE-i initiation due to bradykinin/substance P.

differentials.name: Bronchiectasis
differentials.highYield: Copious foul-smelling purulent sputum with blood streaks. Tram-track sign and signet ring sign on high-res CT.

differentials.name: Bronchogenic Carcinoma
differentials.highYield: Elderly smoker with weight loss, persistent cough, and hemoptysis. Central vs peripheral mass on CT.

differentials.name: Tuberculosis
differentials.highYield: Cavitary lesions in apical/posterior segments of upper lobes, night sweats, positive AFB stain.

differentials.name: Hypoglycemia
differentials.highYield: Diaphoresis, tremors, confusion. Point-of-care blood glucose is the essential first test. Give IV dextrose.

differentials.name: Bacterial Meningitis
differentials.highYield: Fever, headache, altered mental status, nuchal rigidity (Brudzinski & Kernig signs). High WBC, low glucose, high protein on LP.

differentials.name: Sepsis / Septic Encephalopathy
differentials.highYield: Systemic inflammatory response with infection source. Elevated lactate, positive blood cultures.

differentials.name: Subdural Hematoma
differentials.highYield: Elderly or alcoholic with bridging vein tear after minor head trauma. Crescent-shaped hyperdense collection crossing suture lines.

differentials.name: Acute Ischemic Stroke (LVO)
differentials.highYield: Sudden onset focal neurological deficit (FAST). Non-contrast head CT rules out hemorrhage; IV thrombolysis within 4.5h.

differentials.name: Intracerebral Hemorrhage
differentials.highYield: Severe headache, vomiting, rapidly progressive focal deficit in hypertensive patient. Hyperdense blood on non-contrast CT.

differentials.name: Subarachnoid Hemorrhage
differentials.highYield: "Worst headache of my life" (thunderclap). Ruptured berry aneurysm in Circle of Willis.

differentials.name: Migraine
differentials.highYield: Unilateral pulsating headache, photophobia, phonophobia, nausea, +/- aura. Triptans for abortive therapy.

differentials.name: Temporal (Giant Cell) Arteritis
differentials.highYield: Age > 50, jaw claudication, temple tenderness, vision loss risk. High ESR/CRP. Start high-dose steroids immediately.

differentials.name: Cluster Headache
differentials.highYield: Unilateral periorbital excruciating stabbing pain with ipsilateral lacrimation, rhinorrhea, Horner syndrome. 100% O2 abortive.

differentials.name: Guillain-Barré Syndrome
differentials.highYield: Ascending symmetric flaccid weakness, areflexia, post-Campylobacter or viral infection. Albuminocytologic dissociation on LP.

differentials.name: Myasthenia Gravis
differentials.highYield: Fluctuating fatigable weakness worse at end of day, ptosis, diplopia. Anti-AChR antibodies.

differentials.name: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
differentials.highYield: Combined Upper Motor Neuron (hyperreflexia, spasticity) and Lower Motor Neuron (fasciculations, atrophy) signs without sensory loss.

differentials.name: Acute Appendicitis
differentials.highYield: Periumbilical pain migrating to McBurney point (RLQ), rebound tenderness, Rovsing sign.

differentials.name: Acute Cholecystitis
differentials.highYield: RUQ pain radiating to right scapula after fatty meal, Murphy sign positive, ultrasound showing gallbladder wall thickening.

differentials.name: Acute Pancreatitis
differentials.highYield: Epigastric pain radiating straight to back, relieved by leaning forward. Elevated lipase > 3x upper limit.

differentials.name: Choledocholithiasis / Cholangitis
differentials.highYield: Charcot triad (fever, jaundice, RUQ pain); Reynolds pentad (+ hypotension, AMS).

differentials.name: Pancreatic Head Adenocarcinoma
differentials.highYield: Painless progressive jaundice with palpable non-tender gallbladder (Courvoisier sign) and weight loss.

differentials.name: Small Bowel Obstruction
differentials.highYield: Colicky abdominal pain, bilious vomiting, obstipation, dilated bowel loops with air-fluid levels on upright KUB.

differentials.name: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA)
differentials.highYield: Nausea, vomiting, Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath, anion gap metabolic acidosis.

differentials.name: Achalasia
differentials.highYield: Dysphagia to BOTH solids and liquids from onset, regurgitation, "bird-beak" appearance on barium esophagram.

differentials.name: Esophageal Carcinoma
differentials.highYield: Progressive dysphagia starting with solids, then progressing to liquids, weight loss.

differentials.name: Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma
differentials.highYield: Painless gross hematuria in older patient with smoking or occupational chemical exposure.

differentials.name: IgA Nephropathy (Berger Disease)
differentials.highYield: Gross hematuria occurring 1-2 days after upper respiratory or GI infection (synpharyngitic).

differentials.name: Pre-renal Azotemia
differentials.highYield: BUN/Cr ratio > 20:1, FeNa < 1%, urine osmolality > 500 mOsm/kg. Corrects with volume resuscitation.

differentials.name: Acute Tubular Necrosis (ATN)
differentials.highYield: Muddy brown granular casts, BUN/Cr < 15:1, FeNa > 2% due to ischemic or nephrotoxic insult.

differentials.name: Acute Cystitis
differentials.highYield: Frequency, urgency, suprapubic pain, positive urine nitrites and leukocyte esterase. E. coli #1.

differentials.name: Infective Endocarditis
differentials.highYield: New regurgitant murmur, Janeway lesions, Osler nodes, Roth spots, positive Duke criteria.

differentials.name: Adult-Onset Still Disease
differentials.highYield: High quotidian fevers, salmon-pink evanescent rash, arthritis, markedly elevated ferritin.

differentials.name: Occult Malignancy
differentials.highYield: Unintentional loss > 5% body weight in 6-12 months. Cachexia mediated by TNF-alpha (cachectin).

differentials.name: Severe Anemia
differentials.highYield: Pallor, conjunctival rim pallor, exertional dyspnea, tachycardia, low Hb/Hct.

differentials.name: Primary Hypothyroidism
differentials.highYield: Cold intolerance, constipation, dry skin, delayed relaxation of deep tendon reflexes, elevated TSH.

differentials.name: Septic Arthritis
differentials.highYield: Monoarticular warm, red, exquisitely tender joint with severe restriction of passive ROM. Synovial WBC > 50,000.

differentials.name: Gout
differentials.highYield: Podagra (1st MTP joint), negatively birefringent needle-shaped crystals under polarized light.

differentials.name: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome / TEN
differentials.highYield: Full-thickness epidermal sloughing, positive Nikolsky sign, involvement of >= 2 mucosal surfaces.

differentials.name: Cholestatic Jaundice
differentials.highYield: Bile salt deposition in skin causing generalized intractable pruritus worse on palms/soles.

differentials.name: C1-Esterase Inhibitor Deficiency
differentials.highYield: Hereditary angioedema: recurrent episodes of swelling without urticaria or pruritus, low C4.

differentials.name: Meningococcemia
differentials.highYield: Purpuric rash with fever, rapid progression to septic shock and DIC (Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome).
